summary: The focused claim o-89ada9304e7a74ca is a necessary, preexisting coverage gap associated with g0002.

assessment.necessity_reason: Printing an object with a constructed cJSON_Raw member is supported on both sides. The old harness prints only trees returned by parsing, and parsing cannot create a Raw member.

before.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value.
before.reason: The object printer passes member values to print_value, which emits Raw text. cJSON_AddRawToObject provides a supported construction route, but the harness only prints parsed objects; object parsing uses parse_value, whose complete dispatcher has no Raw case.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Provides a supported route to add a Raw member to an object.
Object parsing obtains member values through parse_value.
The complete value dispatcher cannot create a Raw member.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value.
after.reason: The new depth guard permits a shallow object, and Raw member printing remains supported. The same parse-only harness setup still cannot supply that member.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: The supported Raw member construction route remains available.
Object parsing still obtains member values through parse_value.
The complete value dispatcher still cannot create a Raw member.

assessment.comparison_reason: On both sides, the old harness obtains the printed tree solely from cJSON_ParseWithOpts and never adds a Raw member. The same constraint blocks the same printing behavior.
